title: Part sales Create & Edit alone is enough to change a part sale's Bill To
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Part sales → Create & Edit' but not 'Work orders → Create & Edit', at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new part sale for this test, part sale 1, for customer A, open, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Open part sale 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
  4. Pick customer B in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part sale 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Step 3:

  • The list opens.

Step 4:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • Key Decisions: “Changing a work order's Bill To needs 'Work orders → Create & Edit'; a part sale's needs 'Part sales → Create & Edit' or 'Work orders → Create & Edit' (the Change Customer permission).”
